OpenH264 headers and binary DLLs: Cisco Systems, version 2.4.1.
Headers: https://github.com/cisco/openh264/tree/v2.4.1/codec/api/wels
x86 source binary URL: https://ciscobinary.openh264.org/openh264-2.4.1-win32.dll.bz2
x64 source binary URL: https://ciscobinary.openh264.org/openh264-2.4.1-win64.dll.bz2
The DLL files are decompressed unchanged and renamed openh264.dll.
See openh264/LICENSE and openh264/BINARY_LICENSE.txt.

Emoji artwork: Twemoji, copyright Twitter, Inc. and other contributors,
licensed CC BY 4.0, https://github.com/twitter/twemoji .
Ten original PNG images are reused unchanged from the existing Android project.
See LICENSE-EMOJI.txt for the full license.

Windows APIs and the Windows SDK are not redistributed in this package.
Build tools used to verify this package are not runtime dependencies.
